newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani money market rates fluctuate widely.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani money market rates fluctuate widely.

text.p: Pakistan's interbank overnight funds fluctuated widely before closing at 20 percent on paucity of funds on Thursday, dealers said.
Initial bids and offers were at 7.0 percent and 12 percent respectively, but funds started changing hands between 9.0 and 10 percent, a dealer at the Standard Chartered Bank Ltd said.
Despite the inflow of huge amounts into the banking system, the market seemed to be tight after the State (central) Bank conducted a special open market operation, the dealer said.
The market closed at 20 percent, the dealer said.
